Scope: central Party and state media (People's Daily group incl. Overseas Edition, People.cn, Global Times/Huanqiu, China Economic Weekly, the Party members' paper; Xinhua group incl. Economic Information Daily, Reference News, Xinhua Finance; China Media Group incl. CCTV, CGTN, Yuyuan Tantian; Guangming Daily group incl. Zhonghua Dushubao; Economic Daily; China Daily; Qiushi; Study Times; Science and Technology Daily) and one city Party paper (Beijing Daily). Commercial outlets (The Paper, Sina, IT Home, Eastmoney, Tencent News) appear only as carriers.
